title: PanoWorld: Geometry-Consistent Panoramic Video World Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2605.15391v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present PanoWorld, a panoramic video world model that generates geometry-consistent 360$\degree$ video from a single image and a caption. Existing panoramic video methods optimize primarily for visual realism and do not explicitly constrain the underlying 3D scene state, producing outputs that appear plausible yet exhibit inconsistent depth, broken correspondences, and implausible motion across the spherical surface. We address this gap by framing panoramic video generation as a geometry- and dynamics-consistent latent state modeling problem rather than pure visual synthesis. Building on a pre-trained perspective video world model, we introduce two lightweight regularizers: a depth consistency loss against pseudo ground-truth panoramic depth, and a trajectory consistency loss that supervises the 3D world-frame positions of tracked points across time. translated_title: PanoWorld：几何一致的全景视频世界建模
translated_abstract: 我们提出了 PanoWorld，一个能够从单张图像和文本描述生成几何一致的 360° 视频的全景视频世界模型。现有的全景视频方法主要针对视觉真实感进行优化，并未显式约束底层的 3D 场景状态，导致生成的结果虽然看起来合理，但在球面上却存在深度不一致、对应关系断裂以及不合理的运动等问题。为解决这一缺陷，我们将全景视频生成构建为一个几何与动力学一致的潜在状态建模问题，而非纯粹的视觉合成任务。基于一个预训练的透视视频世界模型，我们引入了两个轻量级的正则化项：一个是针对伪真值全景深度的深度一致性损失，另一个是监督被跟踪点在 3D 世界坐标系中随时间变化位置的轨迹一致性损失。我们进一步对条件注入机制应用了球面几何感知的适配
tldr: PanoWorld 将全景视频生成重构为几何与动力学一致的潜在状态建模问题，通过深度一致性和轨迹一致性两个轻量级正则化项，从单张图像生成几何一致的 360° 全景视频。
en_tdlr: PanoWorld generates geometry-consistent 360° panoramic video from a single image by reframing panoramic video generation as a geometry- and dynamics-consistent latent state modeling problem, using two lightweight regularizers for depth and trajectory consistency.
